title: Machine-learning screening of luminogens with aggregation-induced emission characteristics for fluorescence imaging.
summary: Trained wavelength predictors guided three new luminogens; synthesis and optical/imaging measurements validated the predictions. Imaging-material evidence, not clinical efficacy.
ai_technology: Molecular-descriptor regressors including SVM, KNN and gradient boosting
organization: Shenzhen University; Shenzhen University Health Science Center; The University of Sydney

evidence.tested: Trained wavelength predictors guided three new luminogens; synthesis and optical/imaging measurements validated the predictions. Imaging-material evidence, not clinical efficacy.
